topic: Space-Filling Curves: Bridging the Finite and the Infinite
target_audience: University students (STEM majors or interested laypeople)

sections.title: The Intuitive Paradox (0:00-0:45)
lecture_lines: Can a 1D line fill a 2D space?
But math reveals a surprising reality.
Let us explore the space-filling curve.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Limit Process (0:45-1:45)
lecture_lines: We start with a simple finite line.
We repeatedly apply a folding rule.
The shape grows more complex each step.

lecture_lines: Giuseppe Peano defined this process formally.
Every point finds its unique address.
No gaps remain in the limit.

sections.title: Conceptual Synthesis: Finite vs. Infinite (3:15-4:15)
lecture_lines: Finite steps create a thin line.
Infinite limits form a solid area.
The dimension concept is transformed here.

lecture_lines: They pack antennas into small spaces.
